Typo 2.6.2 has a new logo.

## Download

| Platform | File | How to start it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Linux, x86-64 | `typo-2.6.2-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Unpack it and run `./install.sh`. Then open Typo from the app launcher, or run `typo`. |
| macOS, Apple silicon | `typo-2.6.2-macos-arm64.zip` | Unzip it and move `Typo.app` to Applications. The app is not notarized, so right-click it and choose **Open** the first time. |
| Windows, x86-64 | `typo-2.6.2-windows-x86_64.zip` | Unzip it and run `typo.exe`. The app is not signed, so Windows SmartScreen can warn you. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. |

There is no Android APK.

In Typo 2.0.0 or later, select **Update** at the top right to install this version. Quire 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 can't install Typo themselves: see the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/kurtlieber/typo/releases/tag/v2.0.0) to move from Quire.

## Changed since 2.6.1

- **New logo.** Typo's icon is now a lowercase t beside an amber text caret, on a dark tile, the logo of Kurt's earlier editor named typo. It replaces Quire's three sheets in the launcher, the dock, the taskbar and the window, on the welcome screen, and in the README.
- On Linux, run `./install.sh` from the release archive again if your launcher still shows the old icon: the **Update** button replaces the program but not the icon files.
